GTC: TIGER CREEK-ROCKVILLE-NORTH SPA 230KV PROJECT
Teams # 21094

Build a new 4 - breaker 230kV ring bus at Rockville substation (no auto transformer to be added at this time). Loop in the Eatonton Primary #2 - Wallace Dam 230kV line. Build a new line 230kV line to Tiger Creek. Build a new 230kV line to North Spa.
